info.title: The Greatest Demon Lord Is Reborn as a Typical Nobody
info.synopsis: Essendo il più potente di tutti i tempi, il signore dei demoni Varvatos pensa che la vita sia noiosa. L'entità decide di reincarnarsi in un corpo dal potere magico non elevato, ma crescendo vede che gli altri sono molto deboli in confronto. Rinato sotto il nome di Ard non si ferma davanti a nulla per raggiungere il suo obiettivo finale.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Due to the isolation caused by his strength, the Demon Lord Varvatos longed for a normal life, and after several thousand years he reincarnated as the villager, Ard Meteor. His dream is to forge bonds of friendship with other humans. However, even after turning 10 he still had yet to achieve his goal. During that time he has a fateful encounter with a young girl fighting monsters in the forest.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Though he joined the magic academy, what awaited him was far from a normal life. Without realizing it Ard had already grown famous and he was quickly put on a pedestal by his peers. Then there was another problem within his class - the young girl, Ginny, a succubus, was being abused by Elraldo, a noble's son. Ireena then intervenes and Elraldo insults her. When Ard demands an apology, he is challenged to a duel instead.
